text:
Maya (PM): kicking off a short thread — draft PRD for Dedicated Capacity SLA/throughput/autoscale is in the doc. want quick sync on acceptance criteria + edge cases before i send to execs.

Derek (Eng): skimmed — looks sensible. question: are p95 targets global or per-tenant?

Maya (PM): per-tenant where we have reserved pools. host tier keeps global defaults. will add a table mapping plan -> p95/throughput.

Olivia (SRE): main ops concerns: burst spikes and network partitions. PRD should define graceful degradation path and fallback model variants. also need alert thresholds and runbook pointers.

Arjun (ML Eng): call out KV cache cold-start and token-billing impact. if cache cold we expect 2-3x latency on first few requests — needs explicit acceptance criteria.

Nadia (CS): customers repeatedly asked for guaranteed tail latency during batch bursts. they prefer predictable revenue offsets if we do fallback to cheaper model. include a customer-facing fallback policy?

Maya (PM): yes — include customer-facing fallback + internal rollout flags. initial proposal: fallback only with explicit consent in contract (opt-in). otherwise we autoscale and degrade non-reserved routes.

Derek (Eng): propose concrete numbers so QA can run tests. current draft suggests these defaults: 
```yaml
sla_defaults:
  reserved_p95_latency: 120ms
  reserved_throughput_per_gpu: 140 tps
  burst_headroom: 2x
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 100
  scale_cooldown: 45s
  scale_step: 1
```
We should validate these on g4/g5-equivalents.

Olivia (SRE): I want explicit canary + chaos tests: network egress loss, disk fill, control-plane lag. Add acceptance criteria: no more than 5% routed to fallback for non-opt-in customers during a 10m outage.

Arjun (ML Eng): also add a model-variant compatibility matrix for fallbacks. smaller quantized models must preserve output schema and function-calling behavior. failing that, we return structured error not degraded content.

Maya (PM): good. acceptance checklist i plan to add:
- perf: p95 <= target on steady-state + <2x for cold-start of first prefix
- burst: sustain 1.5x baseline for 10m without >10% error rate
- failover: controlled fallback behavior with customer opt-in flag
- billing: cost delta calculation + notice to customer on fallback
- observability: token-level cost and per-route p95 metrics present in console

Nadia (CS): add sample contract language for fallback opt-in and SLA credits. i'll draft and attach.

Derek (Eng): edge-case: multi-tenant GPU oversubscription — we need per-pool throttles not global. if one tenant saturates, autoscaler should not starve others; propose per-tenant token bucket with a shared burst pool.

Olivia (SRE): agree. also capture limits for quorum-loss scenarios: if control plane can't reach a region, we route to regional reserved pools or degrade to best-effort. Acceptance: regional failover within 30s for reserved routes.

Arjun (ML Eng): testing note: include prompt-set regression harness and quality gate — fallback can't change top-1 intent >5% on core prompt set. add eval threshold in PRD.

Maya (PM): action items / owners: 
- Derek: add concrete autoscale knobs + per-tenant throttle design (owner) — due EOD Tues
- Olivia: add runbooks + chaos test checklist (owner) — due Wed
- Arjun: produce model-variant compatibility matrix + regression thresholds (owner) — due Wed
- Nadia: draft fallback opt-in contract language (owner) — due Fri
- Maya: update PRD with acceptance checklist + links to tests, then publish for RFC on Mon

LaunchBot: PRD draft uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/dedicated-capacity/prd-1719876543 (permissions: team/product)

Derek (Eng): one small config snippet for autoscale tests we should include in the doc: 
```json
{"policy":"cpu+queue","target_util":0.6,"max_replicas":50,"burst_multiplier":2}
```

Olivia (SRE): noted — i'll ensure k8s HPA vs our custom scaler behavior is explicit. also add SLI definitions (latency, availability, error-rate) and SLO math for credit calculations.

Maya (PM): thanks everyone. i'll consolidate and post updated PRD by Monday morning. ping me if anything major is missing. :thumbsup:
